tracks.title: A0 — Global Asset Substrate
tracks.subtitle: Built once, reused for every chart. Classical texts, ephemeris, lookup tables, definitions libraries. Read-only from per-chart build perspective. Separate orchestrator (not in the per-chart DAG).

items.title: Classical RAG corpus (BPHS/Jaimini/KP/Tajaka/Phaladeepika/Saravali/Brihat Jataka)
items.desc: Already ~4,589 chunks. Add Phaladeepika, Saravali, Brihat Jataka if not present. Vertex AI 768-dim embedded.

items.title: Ephemeris daily 1950-2100
items.desc: All 9 grahas + asteroids + outer planets + Lilith. Per-day positions, speeds, declinations.

items.title: Ephemeris monthly + yearly aggregates
items.desc: Pre-computed sign-changes, retrograde windows, station longitudes.

items.title: Eclipse table 1950-2100
items.desc: Solar + lunar eclipses with type, magnitude, path, saros cycle.

items.title: Retrograde table 1950-2100
items.desc: All retrograde windows for each non-luminary graha + outer planets.

items.title: Sankranti table 1950-2100 (per ayanamsha)
items.desc: Sun's sign-entry timestamps per ayanamsha. 5× for canonical ayanamshas.

items.title: Daily panchanga 1950-2100 (per ayanamsha)
items.desc: Tithi/vara/nakshatra/yoga/karana + full enrichment. Existing build covers 1900-2100; extend per-ayanamsha.

impl.notes: Lahiri only currently; extend to 5 ayanamshas

items.title: Choghadiya/Hora/Kalam windows
items.desc: Per-(date, latitude) inauspicious + auspicious time windows. Already in panchanga_daily enrichment.

items.title: Nakshatra attribute reference
items.desc: 27 rows × deity, gana, nadi, yoni, pakshi, varna, tatva, ruling-graha, symbol, paramayus, pada-deities.

items.title: Sign attribute reference
items.desc: 12 rows × lord, element, modality, gender, direction, body-part, gemstone, mantra-syllable, drekkana lords.

items.title: Graha attribute reference
items.desc: 9 rows × significations, friendships, exaltation, debilitation, mooltrikona, own signs, mantra, gemstone, color, day, direction, deity, body-part-rulership, varna, tatva, gunas.

items.title: Yoga definitions library (200+)
items.desc: Every classical yoga (Pancha Mahapurusha, Raj yogas, Dhan yogas, Vipareeta, Neechabhanga, Sunafa/Anapha/Durdhura, Vesi/Vasi/Ubhayachari, Adhi, Gajakesari, Saraswati, Akhanda Samrajya, Khsetra, Parijata, etc.) with constituent-rule, classical citation, activation predicate.

items.title: Dosha definitions library
items.desc: Mangal, Kaal Sarpa (12-type), Pitru, Matri, Naga, Sarpa, Guru Chandal, Grahan, Daridra, Shakata, Vish, Punarphoo, Angarak, Visha — full classical set with predicate + citation.

items.title: Saham formula library (50+ Tajik sahams)
items.desc: Each Saham = formula (e.g., Punya = Moon − Sun + Lagna for day birth; reverse for night). Punya/Vidya/Yasas/Vivah/Karma/Bhagya/Putra/Aaayur/Mrityu/Roga/etc.

items.title: Dasha-system rule library (32 systems)
items.desc: Starting-lord rule, sequence, year-table, applicability per system: Vimshottari/Ashtottari/Yogini/Shodashottari/Dvadashottari/Panchottari/Shatabdika/Chatturashitika/Dvisaptati/Shashtihayani/Shatatrimshat/Tara + Jaimini Chara/Sthira/NiryanaShoola/Trikona/Brahma/Vimsa/Sudasa/Drig/Naisargika/Mandukya/Padakrama + Mudda/Patyayini/Sahama + Kalachakra/Sphuta/Vidhanottari/Hadda.

items.title: Varga formula library (30+ vargas)
items.desc: Sign-assignment formulas for D1-D60 Parashari + Jaimini variants + Nadi D108/D150/D2700 + supplementary D5/D6/D8/D11/D14/D15/D21/D32/D33/D50/D54.

items.title: Aspect rule library
items.desc: Parashari graha-drishti (7H + special 4/7/8 Mars, 5/7/9 Jup, 3/7/10 Sat, 5/7/9 Rahu/Ketu) + Jaimini rasi-drishti (fixed-sign rules) + Tajik 5-type with orb tables.

items.title: Friendship reference (natural 9×9)
items.desc: Per-graha-pair natural friendship table (classical canon). Temporal + composite are per-chart.

items.title: Karaka assignment reference
items.desc: Natural karakas per house (1st=Sun, 2nd=Jupiter, 3rd=Mars...) per significance (career=Sun, marriage=Venus/Jupiter...) classical.

items.title: Ayanamsha registry + values over time
items.desc: 5 canonical + capability-only ayanamshas with formula, epoch pin, current value, derivative-per-year, classical citation. Function ayanamsha_value(jd, id) → degrees.

items.title: Sade Sati Saturn-sign-changes (per ayanamsha)
items.desc: Every Saturn sign-ingress 1950-2100 per ayanamsha. Per-chart sade sati derived by joining with native's natal Moon sign.

items.title: Tara bala matrix (27×27)
items.desc: (natal_nakshatra, transit_nakshatra) → tara_class (Janma/Sampat/Vipat/Kshema/Pratyak/Sadhaka/Vadha/Mitra/Atimitra). Global lookup; per-chart Tara bala is a join.

items.title: Chandra bala matrix (12×12)
items.desc: (natal_moon_sign, transit_moon_sign) → favorable/neutral/unfavorable. Global lookup.

items.title: Vimshottari starting-lord table
items.desc: 27 nakshatras → starting Vimshottari dasha lord + sub-fraction. Static.

items.title: Mrityubhaga / Gandanta / Pushkara reference
items.desc: Each = sign-degree predicate; predicate is global, per-chart firing derived.

items.title: Muhurta auspiciousness reference
items.desc: Classical tithi/vara/nakshatra/yoga/karana scoring tables. Choghadiya/Hora/Abhijit/Brahma muhurta computations.

items.title: Remedial library
items.desc: Per-graha mantras + bija mantras + Vedic suktas + stotrams + gemstone + metal + color + charity object + ritual + fasting day. Classical citations.

items.title: Classical worked-examples library
items.desc: Famous charts from BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman's 300 Combinations, KS Charak + classical horoscopes with attributed predictions/outcomes. Used for M6 anchors + divergence-dividend research.

items.title: Calendrical era conversion table
items.desc: Gregorian ↔ Vikram ↔ Shaka ↔ Kali ↔ Saptarshi era for every JD 1950-2100. Partial in panchanga_daily.

items.title: Fixed star catalog (~50 stars)
items.desc: Spica, Regulus, Antares, Aldebaran, Sirius, Canopus/Agastya, Vega — bright stars with longitudes per ayanamsha + precessed coordinates.

items.title: Mantra/Stotra library (~200 entries)
items.desc: 9 Navagraha mantras + 9 bija mantras + Gayatri family + Maha Mrityunjaya + Hanuman Chalisa + Lakshmi/Saraswati/Durga stotras + Aditya Hridaya + Vishnu Sahasranama. Sanskrit + transliteration + meaning + frequency + classical citation.

items.title: Gemstone reference
items.desc: 9 primary + 9 substitute gemstones per graha + weight + metal + finger + day + activation procedure + classical citation (Garuda Purana, Mani-mala).

items.title: Yantra reference
items.desc: Navagraha Yantras + Sri Yantra + Vastu yantras with structural data + activation procedure.

items.title: Compatibility (Ashta Koota / Dasa Koota / Manglik) rules
items.desc: Full classical compatibility tables: 8 kootas (Varna/Vashya/Tara/Yoni/Graha Maitri/Gana/Bhakoot/Nadi) + extended 10-koota. Manglik-cancellation rules.

items.title: Muhurta rule library (30+ activity types)
items.desc: Per activity (marriage, griha-pravesh, journey, education, surgery, business launch, vehicle, etc.): rule set + lagna requirements + dosha avoidances. Used by muhurta_finder.

items.title: Vedic ritual library
items.desc: Per occasion: sankalpa + ritual sequence + classical citation. Used to generate per-chart ritual recommendations.

items.title: Career/profession mapping by graha
items.desc: Classical professions per graha (medicine/law/engineering/arts/government/education...). BPHS Ch. 81-83 + Phaladeepika + modern interpretations.

items.title: Lal Kitab corpus
items.desc: Pt. Roop Chand's early-20th-c. Punjab tradition. ~17 classical Lal Kitab books with remedy + interpretation rules. Distinct corpus alongside BPHS/Jaimini/KP.

items.title: Bhrigu Samhita extracts
items.desc: Public-domain palm-leaf extracts with per-graha-position predictive rules. Distinct from BPHS rule patterns.

items.title: Nadi astrology lookup tables
items.desc: (a) D150 lord per nakshatra-pada-sub + rishi-name (Vasishtha/Atri/Bhrigu/Agastya/Bharadwaja, 27 rishis). (b) D2700 sub-rishi extension. (c) Bhrigu-Nadi yoga rule extensions. (d) Krishnamurti Nadi extensions.

items.title: Ayurveda mapping
items.desc: Per nakshatra + sign + graha → Vata/Pitta/Kapha primary + secondary. Body-part mapping (Kalapurusha — 12 signs to 12 body regions). Disease prediction per-graha-affliction.

items.title: Tantric correspondences
items.desc: Sri Vidya → graha → bija → chakra (Muladhara through Sahasrara) → mantra-syllable. Esoteric Tantric Vedic.

items.title: Numerology overlays
items.desc: Pythagorean + Chaldean + Vedic Ank-jyotish per nakshatra/graha/name. Syncretic cross-system convergence detection.

items.title: Mundane astrology calendar
items.desc: Jupiter-Saturn conjunctions (every ~20y, 1950-2100). Other slow-planet alignments. Historical correlation table.

items.title: Bhrigu Bindu transit lookup
items.desc: Bhrigu Bindu moves at Moon-Rahu midpoint pace; precompute position 1950-2100 for per-chart transit calculations.

items.title: Tajik tables
items.desc: Hadda lords per sign (5-fold), Tajik aspect orb tables, Year-lord computation rules (Vargottama / Triraashipathi / Hadda), Mudda/Patyayini computation rules. Used by varshphal.

items.title: Mundane sankashti calendar
items.desc: Vedic months + sankashti chaturthi (Ganesha) + ekadashi (Vishnu) + amavasya/purnima dates 1950-2100 with auspicious-class. Partly in panchanga_daily.

tracks.title: A1–A14 — Per-Chart Deterministic Build
tracks.subtitle: Engine + L1 + L1.5 + L2.5 synthesis per chart, per ayanamsha (5×). Sequential DAG executed by build orchestrator. Order flexible during refinement.

items.title: Engine invocation (5 ayanamshas)
items.desc: natal_engine.compute_chart() runs 5× in parallel. 23 bodies (9 grahas + 2 nodes ×2 + 2 Liliths + 10 asteroids/outer). Heliocentric + decl + RA emitted. G1_internal_invariants verification (no jh_parity gate).

items.title: FORENSIC.md render
items.desc: 44 H2 sections. Per-chart per-ayanamsha. No narration; deterministic values only (linter-enforced). RAG chunking + Vertex embedding. Cross-ayanamsha report.

brief.notes: Native confirmed chunking IN with no-narration constraint. F.13-F.14 decisions pending.

items.title: chart_facts table population
items.desc: Every atom from A1+A2 as rows. ~50 fact_category enum. Stable fact_ids (sha256-derived). Citation strings per row. Materialized views.

items.title: Panchanga (birth-day)
items.desc: 5 limbs + Tara bala + Chandra bala + Choghadiya/Hora/Kalams + auspicious windows + solar context + calendrical + Eclipse proximity + special vara+nakshatra combinations.

items.title: Sensitive points
items.desc: 6 upagrahas + Saturn-derived + esoteric bindus (Bhrigu/Yogi/Avayogi/Mrityu/Trisphuta) + 11 Special Lagnas + 50+ Sahams + 12 Arudhas + 8 Jaimini chara karakas + Karakamsa/Swamsa + midpoints.

items.title: Vargas (30+ divisional charts)
items.desc: 16 Parashari (D1-D60) + supplementary (D5/D6/D8/D11/D14/D15/D21/D32/D33/D50/D54) + Nadi (D108/D150/D2700). Per-varga lagna + 9 grahas + dignity + vargottama. Two-pass verification.

items.title: Dashas (32 systems)
items.desc: Nakshatra-based (Vimshottari + 11 others) + Jaimini (12 systems) + Tajik (4 systems) + Special (4). Depth Sookshma minimum. Two-pass verification mandatory.

items.title: T1 structural facts
items.desc: Aspect matrix (Parashari + Jaimini + Tajik) + dispositors + shadbala (6 sub-balas/graha) + ashtakavarga (BAV + SAV + reductions + kakshyas) + yogas register (200+) + vimshopaka + bhava bala + ishta-kashta + 5 avastha schemes.

items.title: Sade Sati cycles
items.desc: Saturn-Moon natal relationship → all sade sati 7.5y windows past+future + intensity per quarter. Depends on natal Moon sign per ayanamsha.

items.title: MSR (Multi-System Register)
items.desc: Every observable signal as row — no threshold drop. {configuration, constituent_facts[], classical_sources[], deterministic_strength, verification_certainty, computed_salience, salience_formula_version, domains_affected}. Projected 800-1,500 signals.

items.title: CDLM (Cross-Domain Linkage Matrix)
items.desc: 9 domains × 9 (career/relationships/health/wealth/family/learning/spirituality/longevity/character). Each cell = computable shared-factor count between MSR signals tagged for those domains + linkage strength.

items.title: CGM (Chart Graph Model)
items.desc: Nodes = grahas + houses + signs + configurations + arudhas. Edges = structural relations (aspect/dispositor/lordship/karaka/conjunction/parivartana/mutual reception). Weighted by computed strength.

items.title: RM (Resonance Map)
items.desc: Weakest grahas (low shadbala + bad dignity + low ashtakavarga) → classical remedy candidates. Strongest grahas → amplification candidates. Spoke structure from center.

items.title: UCN digest (computed signature)
items.desc: Top-K configurations by computed_salience + dominant + weakest grahas + strongest yogas + current dasha context + system-convergence counts. No prose. Replaces 102-section narrative UCN.

tracks.title: A15–A20 — Supplementary Per-Chart (proposed)
tracks.subtitle: Items I flagged as 'possibly missing'. Native to confirm inclusion. Could fold into A1-A14 or run as separate batch.

items.title: Chakras (Sarvatobhadra / Sapta-shalaka / Kalanala / Kota)
items.desc: Geometric chakra positions per graha. Used for vedha (obstruction) timing.

items.title: Vedha calculations
items.desc: Graha-aspect-obstruction tables. Per-chart vedha-timing lookups.

items.title: Argala / Virodha argala matrices (Jaimini)
items.desc: 12×12 intervention matrix per chart per ayanamsha. From signs onto signs.

items.title: Bhrigu Bindu per-chart transit table
items.desc: Bhrigu Bindu lifetime transit positions for this chart. Cached for timing queries.

items.title: Specific Tajik tables (per chart)
items.desc: Hadda lord per sign + Tajik aspect-counts + Year-lord per varsha. Per-chart varshphal-prep.

items.title: Per-graha next-exact-aspect lifetime table
items.desc: When each natal graha receives exact transit aspect from each other graha 1950-2100. Hot-moment timing.
